verdict.rationale: Pigment documents its own capabilities for pulling in source data through native connectors, open APIs and scheduled imports, building planning models (Modeler Agent), and running variance analysis on the same platform as the plan. That covers the general shape of planning and tracking against actuals. However, nothing in the evidence specifically mentions revenue planning, CRM pipeline data, or subscription/ARR data. Missing for 10: explicit revenue-planning use case, documented CRM (e.g. Salesforce/HubSpot) pipeline or subscription-billing connectors, revenue plan-vs-actuals tracking specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration.
